prompt_en:
Photorealistic transport editorial of an original adult woman working as a night-ferry vehicle-deck loadmaster, fully clothed in a navy coverall, reflective vest, steel-toe boots, hard hat, and gloves. Her facial appearance is guided only by the provided reference photograph. On the night ferry's vehicle deck, she pauses between numbered loading lanes beside cargo chains. Frame her full body in a clearly readable natural contrapposto from hard hat to both boot soles with floor margin: most weight on one straight support leg; opposite leg relaxed or bent, its knee soft and foot touching lightly ahead; pelvis and shoulders tilt in opposed balance; stable head-to-feet full-body balance across the complete standing figure. One gloved hand marks the checklist as she turns toward an arriving truck. Keep hips, knees, ankles, and feet unobstructed, making the load path obvious. Cool overhead work lights and warm ramp lamps rake across the shoulder and pelvic lines; wet anti-slip steel, chain tensioners, bay numerals, and distant vehicle lamps establish the operation. Eye-level 50mm documentary realism, natural fabric folds, physically plausible joints, and a work-focused expression.
Reference roles for targeted repair: Image 1 is the previous generated edit target; Image 2 guides facial appearance only. Preserve Image 1's full-body framing, ferry setting, workwear, clipboard, lighting, straight image-left loaded support leg, bent image-right free leg, and both visible boots. Change only counter-tilt readability: the pelvis rises over the loaded support hip and drops toward the free-leg side, while the shoulder line visibly slopes the opposite way at thumbnail scale and the head stays balanced over the support foot.
Avoid: over-processed retouching, impossible perspective, low resolution, warped product geometry, 3D render look, illustration look, inaccurate reflections, fake-looking background, broken window geometry
